newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-GREECE STAY TOP AFTER DRAW WITH CROATIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GREECE STAY TOP AFTER DRAW WITH CROATIA.

text.p: Greece surprisingly held Croatia 1-1 in a World Cup qualifier on Sunday to remain top of European group one.
Four Croats and five Greeks were booked in a match riddled with niggling fouls.
The Greeks stunned the hosts by taking the lead in the ninth minute when Demis Nikolaidis fired home from the edge of the penalty area.
Alen Boksic volleyed against a post but the Croats finally equalised just before halftime when Davor Suker pounced on a loose ball and found a gap between two Greek defenders and the goalkeeper.
Another Suker effort was disallowed for offside and Boksic's low left-footer shaved a post minutes later.

Croatia: 1-Drazen Ladic, 13-Mario Stanic, 3-Robert Jarni, 4-Igor Stimac (14-Zvonimir Soldo 53), 5-Nikola Jerkan, 6-Slaven Bilic, 7-Aljosa Asanovic, 8-Robert Prosinecki (19-Goran Vlaovic 71), 10-Zvonimir Boban, 9-Davor Suker, 11-Alen Boksic.

Greece: 1-Ilias Atmatsidis, 2-Sestratios Apostolakis, 3-Michail Kasapis, 4-Kyriakos Karatiadis, 5-Ioannis Kalitzakis, 6-Nikolaos Dabizas, 7-Theodoros Zagorakis (16-Michalis Vlachos 46), 8-Demis Nikolaidis, 9-Konstantinos Konstantinidis, 10-Vasileios Tsartas (Zissis Vryzas 83), 11-George Donis (17-George Georgiakis 69).
